name: fuelmap_unet_v1
format: PyTorch state_dict (plain keys, no 'module.' prefix); all floating-point tensors float32; load with torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
description: Release model for Zhu, Dixon & Jin (2026), Remote Sensing of Environment 333, 115091. Retrained in June 2024 on the paper's training tiles (June 2024 version of the split, test tiles held out); it matches the paper's reported overall accuracy (87.1% on the public one-year test array; paper: 87.1%). It is the release model, not the exact checkpoint behind the paper's tables.
citation: Zhu, Y., Dixon, D. J., & Jin, Y. (2026). Scalable sub-meter mapping of woody vegetation and structures across California's heterogeneous landscape using deep learning. Remote Sensing of Environment, 333, 115091. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2025.115091

classes.4: legacy 'unlabeled' channel (never a training target; never predicted; drop at inference)

decision_rule_paper.description: softmax over the 5 logits, use channels 0-3; tree if p_tree > 0.4 and NDVI > 0.11; shrub if p_shrub > 0.4 and NDVI > 0.11; building if p_building > 0.6; then other if p_other > 0.5 (applied last, overrides); all remaining pixels other. NDVI = (NIR - R) / (NIR + R) computed on DN / 255 (0 where NIR + R = 0).

training.training_data: 4-year training array, 10,969 tile-years: 6,649 tiles at their LiDAR-matched NAIP year (1,725 urban building-only + 4,924 WUI/wildland; the June 2024 cut of the paper's training split, whose final version lists 7,015 training tiles) plus 4,320 rows of WUI tiles at the other NAIP years (2016/2018/2020/2022)
training.checkpoint_selection: last epoch at which Dice and mIoU on the test arrays both improved (rule of the training code)
training.loss: cross-entropy, class weights [other 0.4, tree 1.0, shrub 1.1, building 1.5, unlabeled 0]; ignore_index 4 was set but never triggered (see unlabeled_pixels)
training.unlabeled_pixels: no-label pixels (value 4 in the 2024 arrays, 255 in the release packages) were encoded as class 0 (other) by the archived training data loader, so they were trained as other with loss weight 0.4
training.multi_gpu: trained with torch.nn.DataParallel; the 'module.' key prefix was removed for this release
training.public_training_packages: fuelmap_train_4y_part01..06of06.npz hold 10,218 of the 10,969 training rows. The 751 urban building-only rows whose labels were rasterized from the San Luis Obispo County building-footprint layer are not distributed, because that layer's terms do not allow redistribution.

evaluation_1y_test_array.data: public one-year test array fuelmap_test_1y.npz: 693 tiles at the LiDAR-matched NAIP year (the 806-tile June 2024 test array without its 113 San Luis Obispo urban building-only tiles); 162 of the 693 tiles carry building-only labels; pixels with label 'no label' ignored; rows = reference, columns = prediction; UA = precision, PA = recall

provenance.conversion: stripped 'module.' prefix, cast to float32, torch.save(state_dict); outputs verified bit-identical to the source checkpoint on 2 test tiles (array rows 0 and 400)
